videos.title: Resumen del fútbol
videos.script:
¡Bienvenidos a Fútbol al Minuto!
Resumen del fútbol.

Burn replaces injured Guehi in England squad.
Newcastle's Dan Burn is added to the England squad to play Croatia and Spain in the Nations League this week after Marc Guehi pulls out with a hip injury.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Incident-by-incident: Was it a bad weekend for VAR?.
Almost every game had a controversial VAR decision in the Premier League this weekend. But how many might go down as errors?
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Alisson wants to sign new Liverpool contract.
Liverpool goalkeeper Alisson Becker wants to stay at the club beyond the end of the season, when his current contract is set to expire.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Chelsea staff warned over Fantasy Premier League use.
Chelsea warn staff to be careful about revealing team news through Fantasy Premier League after Joao Pedro's injury appeared to have been inadvertently disclosed through team selections.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Fishlock retires after record-breaking career.
Wales' record cap-holder and goalscorer, Jess Fishlock, hangs up her boots after Seattle Reign were beaten in the NWSL play-offs.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Actualidad internacional.

Dutch match postponed after fans block team bus.
A Dutch second-tier match between Vitesse Arnhem and De Graafschap was called off after away team supporters blocked their own team's bus from departing for the game.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Musiala may never return to his best - Hoeness.
Bayern Munich honorary president Uli Hoeness questions whether forward Jamal Musiala will ever "regain the performance level he once had".
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Bizarre & thrilling theatre as Carrick in limbo with Man Utd in drop zone.
It was a Premier League classic at Old Trafford but what has Manchester United's 4-4 draw with Aston Villa done to Michael Carrick's future?
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Villa's Kamara on Chelsea watchlist - Monday's gossip.
Aston Villa midfielder Boubacar Kamara is on Chelsea's watchlist, Manchester United could make an offer for Nottingham Forest's Murillo, plus more.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

What can you read into Premier League table after 10 games?.
With 10 games gone in the Premier League season, BBC Sport looks at what history tells us we can read into the table at this stage.
Fuente: BBC Sport.
